Full time and part time employees may participate in the Company’s ESPP, provided they meet certain
eligibility requirements. Effective January 1, 2009, the purchase price for the Company’s common stock under
the terms of the ESPP is defined as 95% of the closing stock price on the last trading day of a purchase. During
2010 and 2009, the Company issued 179,634 and 214,004 shares, respectively, under the ESPP.

Options to purchase an average of 7.5 million, 18.1 million and 5.7 million shares of common stock during
the years ended December 31, 2010, 2009 and 2008, respectively, were outstanding but were not included in the
computation of diluted net earnings per share because the exercise prices of the options were greater than the
average market price of common stock for those periods.
